name: Vercel MCP
summary: Vercel's official remote MCP server at mcp.vercel.com, an OAuth-authenticated endpoint that gives an AI assistant access to a Vercel account: the vendor lists searching and navigating Vercel documentation, managing projects and deployments, analysing deployment logs, querying Web Analytics and inspecting Agent Runs. The vendor says the tool set splits into public tools (no authentication) and authenticated tools; measured 2026-09-21, initialize, tools/list and a direct call of the documentation tool all answer 401 with the same Bearer challenge.

payments.notes: 2026-09-21: nothing read prices an agent call or speaks a 402 protocol; the MCP server is gated by OAuth, not by a price. Pro billing FAQ: "What payment methods are available? Credit/Debit card only." Enterprise adds ACH and wire on invoices finalised in Stripe. Hobby is free.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-12 and 2026-09-21, no credentials, cloud IP: MCP initialize, tools/list and a tools/call of search_vercel_documentation each answer 401 with the same Bearer challenge; resource_metadata names vercel.com as the authorization server, scope openid. No public tool was reached.

jobs.summary: Vercel MCP, the vendor's words: it lets an AI assistant "Search and navigate Vercel documentation", scoped to Vercel's own documentation, alongside its project and deployment tools. Not measured: an unauthenticated initialize answered 401, so the documentation tool was not reached.
